canonical_purpose: Convert rack telemetry into bounded useful-token allocation decisions under explicit thermal, coolant, power, network, health, and reserve-capacity envelopes.

prometheus_integration.proved: bounded Prometheus parsing plus real local HTTP scrape-to-allocation path

stateful_control_loop.proved: hysteresis, cooldown, emergency override, allocation materiality, and persisted loop state

deployment.reason: The repository is a local/reference infrastructure-control tool. Production deployment would require environment-specific workload and physical-control authority outside the repository's independent purpose.
